author: lordteddey
body:
Right, these are a few ideas which potentially could improve this server. I think we all know that Nebula is dominating the games section; however, if we add quality games into the server, I can a sure you that it will attract more players. 

Factions: 
We can have two factions servers which can produce normal mcmmo, and Potion Factions.

FFA:

This is a great gamemode which can certainly attract a large amount of players. Players seem to go out and find other servers to: 1v1, practice, or just FFA.


Also, a few people have been complaining about teamstacking, and getting targeted. I know how to stop this, we can have a disguise command, with people having YT ranks, and donors. People teamstack because there is a  certain player, who is very good, so they teamstack to win the game, if that player disguise, it will reduce the amount of teamstackers. Also, if a player gets targeted, they can disguise.

title: Few Things

replies.author: SnowSX3
replies.body:
I don't know if having a disguise command for everyone would work.
It could get seriously abused.
I think only staff and some hand-picked individuals should have access to this command.

I love the free for all idea, it could add a unique and different dynamic to Avicus.
It would definitely garner some attention.

Maybe add a UHC factions to add another challenge?
Again, the factions idea would most probably bring new players to Avicus.
It could also possibly bring teams together as they could team up?

Great suggestions PM!!

replies.body:
FFA: I made a thread about it a while ago and ParaSpider seemed to like it. I really hope it gets added. 

Factions: factions won't work for us sorry. But don't get me wrong. I love factions (one of my favorite servers is a faction server), it's just that they produce horrible communities.  VvScamming, ddosing, and infighting can be some of the results of factions. 

A UHC gamemode would be nice, too.
